internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Every attested token of this root (all Form I imperfect, masculine plural: تَجْـَٔرُونَ / يَجْـَٔرُونَ / لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا) describes people crying out under duress. In 16:53 the cry is triggered by harm (ٱلضُّرُّ) and directed 'to Him' (فَإِلَيْهِ). In 23:64 the punished affluent ones (مُتْرَفِيهِم) cry out the instant the punishment (ٱلْعَذَاب) seizes them, with no stated addressee. In 23:65 that same cry is forbidden and declared futile — 'do not cry out today; you will not be helped (لَا تُنصَرُونَ)' — which retro-construes the outcry as a plea for rescue. So the root names the affliction-driven outcry-for-relief itself, morally neutral, not a formulated prayer, not a guarantee of being answered, and not inherently addressed to God.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT lexicalize: (1) a divine addressee — 'to Him' comes only from the preposition إِلَيْهِ in 16:53 and is absent in 23:64; (2) efficacy — 23:65 (لَا تُنصَرُونَ) explicitly denies rescue despite the cry; (3) legitimate worship/piety — the criers in 23:64 are the condemned مُتْرَفُون; (4) articulate/propositional speech — no content is ever quoted, it is raw vocal outcry; (5) a settled state/disposition — it is punctual and crisis-triggered (إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ, إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ); (6) silence/inwardness — it is an overt act that can be commanded to cease (لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 23:64 (يَجْـَٔرُونَ) is bare — no addressee and no explicit appeal — so read in isolation it could denote a mere wordless scream of anguish, undercutting the 'appeal for relief' component and favoring a thinner acoustic-only nucleus. It is neutralized by its own continuation 23:65 ('do not cry out today; you will not be helped'), which construes that very cry as a plea for rescue; it therefore caps the pragmatic 'appeal' layer as context-reinforced rather than breaking the affliction-outcry nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A more minimal acoustic/manner nucleus: جأر = merely 'to emit an urgent/clamorous cry,' with distress, directedness, and appeal ALL contributed by context (ٱلضُّرّ, ٱلْعَذَاب, إِلَيْهِ, لَا تُنصَرُونَ). With n=3, all crisis-bound and morphologically uniform, this rival cannot be excluded; the richer 'appeal-for-relief' nucleus is preferred only because the frame is unanimous (3/3) and twice carried by verb-adjacent grammar (إِلَيْهِ; لَا تُنصَرُونَ). This is why the claim is held at MODERATE rather than STRONG.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge: a single morphological window (Form I imperfect, plural, qac_verb_form=null), one coherent affliction-outcry nucleus, and NO resistant or lexicalized sub-class. The 16:53-vs-23:64/65 valence gap (rightful turn to God vs. condemned futile clamour) is contextual framing, not a lexical split — the identical act is described in both, so no unbridged multi-class arises and forcing UNRESOLVED would be dishonest. Strength is capped at MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE because STRONG requires broad, distinctive evidence: here the base is narrow (3 tokens, one form/tense, effectively two contexts since 23:64–65 are one continuous scene), the sharpest feature (appeal-for-relief) is partly context-supplied and cannot be proven criterial against the minimalist acoustic rival, and distinctiveness against neighbouring cry/call roots (دعا, نادى, صرخ, استغاث, بكى) cannot be established Quran-internally because no comparanda are in the packet. Scope is DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY/REPRESENTATIVE rather than UNIVERSAL because only one derivational slice is attested. candidate_root_contribution: To raise an urgent, overt (audible) outcry wrung out by acute affliction, functioning as an appeal for relief/rescue. The distress-trigger and appeal-function are the recurrent nucleus; the addressee (God) and the outcome (heard vs. refused) are supplied by context, not by the root.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: Three tokens, all Form I imperfect masc. plural (16:53:12:1 تَجْـَٔرُونَ 2mp; 23:64:8:1 يَجْـَٔرُونَ 3mp; 23:65:2:1 لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ 2mp prohibitive), qac_verb_form=null, qac_pos=V; each embedded in an acute-distress clause (ٱلضُّرُّ / ٱلْعَذَاب).
layer_attribution.derivation: Only one derivational slice is attested (Form I imperfect); no perfect, participle, verbal noun, or other pattern exists in the packet, so the derivational family is untested beyond this window — the basis for REPRESENTATIVE / DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY rather than UNIVERSAL.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: No lexicalized or nominal sub-class is present; the root does not fragment into a settled-noun sense, so no LEXICALIZED_CLASS carve-out and no resistance-based MODERATE cap from a lexicalized class.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Directionality 'to Him' (إِلَيْهِ, 16:53), the punitive trigger (بِٱلْعَذَابِ, 23:64), and the futility/refusal (لَا تُنصَرُونَ, 23:65) are contextual/narrative contributions; they reinforce but must NOT be absorbed into the root claim, which stays addressee-neutral and outcome-neutral.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: The 16:53 (rightful turn to God) vs. 23:64–65 (condemned futile clamour) valence gap is reconciled as contextual framing of one identical act, not a lexical split; 23:64's bare form is reconciled to the nucleus via the adjacent 23:65, yielding a single CONSISTENT cluster with no forced unity across genuine homonyms.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No occurrence resists the nucleus. The only live residual is the sub-question of whether 'appeal for relief' is criterial or a contextual overlay on a bare acoustic 'loud cry' core — unresolved on n=3 and left open (falsification NOT_RUN, distinctiveness_ok=false), not treated as occurrence-level resistance.

hard_cases.reason: Only token with no stated addressee and no explicit appeal; it is the best available lever against building 'appeal for relief' into the root, and the reason that component is graded context-reinforced rather than morphologically intrinsic.

evidence_basis.statement: 23:64 (يَجْـَٔرُونَ) is bare — no addressee and no explicit appeal — so read in isolation it could denote a mere wordless scream of anguish; it is neutralized by its own continuation 23:65 ('do not cry out today; you will not be helped'), which construes that very cry as a plea for rescue, capping the appeal layer without breaking the affliction-outcry nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: There is no RESISTANT occurrence and no lexicalized sub-class, but 23:64 is a genuine adversarial boundary that all three lenses identify; it is represented as an ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY hard case whose evidence_basis is textually anchored in 23:64→23:65 and matches the recorded strongest_counterexample.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence of ج-أ-ر used OUTSIDE an affliction/punishment context — e.g. a calm, private, praising, or ordinary-calling use, or a nominal/participial form denoting settled outcry — which would show the 'acute-distress trigger' is not part of the root but merely a distributional accident of these three tokens.
rejection_condition.search_location: Any further QAC-attested ج-أ-ر (jaʾara / juʾār) token beyond the three in this packet, especially nominal/derived forms or perfect-tense uses not present here.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Confirm the radicals are ج-أ-ر via surface Buckwalter (hamon middle radical, not ج-و-ر), then read the full verse to test whether the trigger is distress/punishment and whether the sense is an outcry-for-relief; check whether إِلَى / a divine addressee is present.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Do NOT conflate this root with ج-و-ر (neighbour/deviation/injustice) despite the packet's 'jAr'/'ج ا ر' label; exclude tokens whose middle radical is و or ا. Treat contextual إِلَيْهِ and لَا تُنصَرُونَ as context, not root content.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If a non-distress, non-appeal use is found, the affliction-outcry nucleus is downgraded to a bare acoustic 'loud cry' core (the minimalist competitor) and the appeal/distress layers are relocated to context; the current MODERATE claim would be narrowed or re-clustered.

reopen_conditions: If any ج-أ-ر token is attested in a non-affliction context (calm/private/praise/ordinary calling) or as a nominal/participial form, re-test whether 'acute-distress trigger' is criterial or merely distributional across 16:53 / 23:64 / 23:65.

If Quran-internal comparanda for other cry/call roots (دعا, نادى, صرخ/استصرخ, استغاث, بكى) become available, test whether ج-أ-ر is distinctively the affliction-driven refused-appeal outcry, which could lift the appeal-for-relief nucleus above the minimalist acoustic competitor.

If a ج-أ-ر occurrence appears with an addressee other than God, or with an explicit successful/answered outcome, re-examine the negative boundaries that the root does not lexicalize an addressee (currently from إِلَيْهِ in 16:53 alone) or efficacy (currently from لَا تُنصَرُونَ in 23:65 alone).

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The affliction-outcry nucleus is adversarially clean across 3/3 with no failing occurrence, so it is not refuted.
